notes: Custom in-editor find/replace bar replaces CodeMirror's panel — VSCode-style layout, real "N of M" counter, draggable opacity & blur sliders, chevron toggles replace, Cmd-F refocuses + seeds from selection on every press. Editor: Tab indents, Cmd-Alt-Up/Down duplicates the line, undo back to the saved buffer now clears the dirty dot. Global search: Aa/ab/.* moved inline into the find input, "…" reveal for files-to-include / exclude, Cmd-Shift-F seeds from selection. Settings: full-pane layout with theme-aware surfaces, no more solid tiles, opacity slider goes 0.00–1.00 with no floor. Project session close-X visible on hover. Agent rail's controls moved from footer to header. Fixed: global search false-cancelling across background sessions; ⌘P opening a file no longer wipes the other tabs; Rundeck pane no longer reports "not configured" on cold boot; rundeck tree-click resets the nav stack.
